ajustez_filtres_creez_nouveau_modele: Adjust your filters or create a new template.
apos_apercu_rafraichi_automatiquement_80: The preview refreshes on its own (about 800 ms after each change).
aucun_modele_n_apos_encore: No template has been loaded into the database yet.
aucun_modele_ne_cible_poste: No template targets this position yet.
aucun_type_evident_detecte_choisissez: No obvious type detected — choose it yourself.
aucune_valeur_remplacable_detectee_conte: No replaceable value detected — the content is imported as is.
bibliotheque_view_modeles_vnk_officiels_: Official and custom VNK templates — contracts, policies and legal documents in one place.
bibliotheque_view_selectionnez_un_poste_: Pick a position to see the recommended templates (contracts, policies, targeted or generic letters).
bibliotheque_view_tu_pourras_ensuite_con: You can then view, duplicate or customize any template.
charger_50_modeles_vnk_officiels: To load the 50+ official VNK templates
choisissez_option_ci_dessous_puis: Pick an option below, then shape the content at the next step.
cliquez_deposez_fichier_ici: Click or drop a file here
collez_ici_texte_document_importer: Paste here the text of the document to import…
collez_moins_20_caracteres_texte: Paste at least 20 characters of text before analysing.
commencez_rediger_utilisez_barre_outils: Start writing… Use the toolbar or the “Insert a field” button to add dynamic elements (name, date, salary…).
comment_souhaitez_vous_demarrer: How would you like to start?
contenu_apparaitra_ici_fois_template: The content shows up here once the template is written.
contenu_importe_variables_appliquees_sub: The imported content with the variables applied. The substitutions are highlighted in blue.
contrats_ententes_double_signature: Contracts and agreements signed twice (employee + employer).
copiez_texte_contrat_lettre_politique: Copy the text of an existing contract, letter or policy.
cree_poste_reutilisable_contrats_profils: Creates a reusable position for contracts and employee profiles.
creez_modele_vide_vous_redigerez: Create an empty template. You write all the content yourself.
decochez_substitutions_vous_ne_souhaitez: Uncheck the substitutions you do not want applied.
determine_quels_blocs_signature_apparait: Decides which signature blocks appear in the final PDF and in the employee preview.
import_template_dialog_collez_un_documen: Paste an existing document or upload it. The system automatically detects the values to turn into dynamic variables.
importez_pdf_docx_txt_vnk: Import a PDF, DOCX or TXT — VNK spots the variables on its own (names, dates, amounts).
impossible_charger_postes: The positions could not be loaded
laissez_vide_appliquer_tous_employes: Leave empty to apply to every employee. Otherwise restrict it to the positions / departments listed.
lettres_attestations_confirmations_emise: Letters, attestations and confirmations issued by VNK.
majorite_documents_necessitent_accuse_le: Most documents (policies, codes, communications) only need a read receipt. Keep the handwritten signature for legal contracts.
modele_redevient_disponible_toutes_selec: The template becomes available again everywhere.
modele_sera_masque_selections_mais: The template is hidden from the pickers but stays readable through the “Include archived” filter.
modifiez_contenu_ciblage_version_pensez: Change the content, the targeting or the version. Bump the version if the content changes much.
obligatoire_contrats_ententes_legales_en: Required for contracts, legal agreements and formal commitments.
partez_modele_vnk_pre_redige: Start from a ready-made VNK template (policy, contract, NDA…).
pdf_vide_retourne_serveur: The server returned an empty PDF
politiques_internes_codes_conduite_accus: Internal policies, codes of conduct, read receipts.
rechercher_modele_politique_contrat: Search a template, a policy, a contract…
recommande_politiques_codes_conduite_com: Recommended for policies, codes of conduct, HR communications.
selectionnez_employe_resoudre_variables_: Pick an employee to resolve the variables (name, position, salary...).
selectionnez_employe_voir_rendu_vraies: Pick an employee to see it rendered with their real data.
selectionnez_poste_voir_tous_modeles: Pick a position to see every template that applies (targeted or generic).
selectionnez_postes_existants_creez_nouv: Pick existing positions or create a new one to aim this template.
sera_propose_defaut_creation_employe: Offered by default when creating an employee in this position.
suivez_etapes_creer_nouveau_modele: Follow the steps to build a reusable template, with dynamic variables and a preview.
template_library_browser_choisissez_un_m: Choose a pre-filled template or start from scratch. You can change everything afterwards.
template_preview_les_champs_employe_cont: Employee and contract fields show a placeholder. Select an employee to replace them with the real data.

template_wizard_inclus_automatiquement_d: Automatically included in the onboarding path of the targeted new employees.
var_desc_a_utiliser_uniquement_dans_docu: For confidential internal HR documents only (TD1, T4, etc.).

var_desc_calcul_auto_startdate_90_jours_: Worked out as startDate + 90 days (3 months, LSA).

var_desc_son_sa_son_epicene_son_ou: his / her / their / “his or her” when unknown.

variable_picker_cliquez_sur_un_champ_pou: Click a field to insert it at the cursor. It is filled automatically with the employee's real data.
verifiez_titre_cle_contenu_min: Check the title, the key and the content (10 characters minimum)
voir_tous_n_documents: See all {count} documents in the grid
